name: scamgate
description: Offline scam gate for Claude Code: blocks known-bad links and risky payments before a tool runs, and asks you when it can't see where a command is going.

auto_update_feeds.title: Refresh the phishing lists automatically
auto_update_feeds.description: Download the phishing lists shortly after a session starts and every 6 hours while Claude Code runs. Turn off to refresh only when Claude calls update_feeds.

urlhaus_auth_key.title: URLhaus Auth-Key (optional)
urlhaus_auth_key.description: Free abuse.ch key that adds the URLhaus malware-link list. Leave empty to skip that list.
